# Immutable synthetic format-2 compatibility golden

`format2.db` and `manifest.json` were generated **before modifying production source**, using the real SQLite store and planner at baseline `de5aa4c4f40c0696e034e2a14fb226437c9214c5`. No user database, credentials, provider call or native UI was used. This fixture remains in use by `ContextBudgetVersionTests`; do not regenerate it with the current planner.

The source conversation contains five synthetic exchanges. Two sibling branches accept replies using a 10000 context budget and 4096 ordinary output limit. Baseline format 2 makes 1024-token summary chunks. The producer completes source-owned summaries; both siblings prepare requests using the same caches, then complete. `manifest.json` freezes configuration, originals, chunks, cache IDs and payload hashes, summary request values, prepared request/reference values, and the stored prepared-format-2 hash.

`GenerateGolden.cs.txt` is the exact generator source used once on the old baseline. For provenance reproduction in a separate baseline checkout, copy it to `tests/Mindweave.Tests/GenerateFormat2Golden.cs` and run:

```sh
MINDWEAVE_GOLDEN_DESTINATION=/absolute/new/output dotnet test tests/Mindweave.Tests/Mindweave.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-restore --filter FullyQualifiedName~GenerateFormat2Golden
```

The historical run passed 1/1 before any production source edits. IDs and timestamps are generated by production APIs, so regeneration produces a new database, not byte-identical golden output. The committed files below are the compatibility oracle; tests copy the database into disposable isolated roots and never modify the golden.

SHA-256 at creation:

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `format2.db` | `7431fb81f3a0c201cb7ab478e27c4ff1308034a3eafb6d47bb17d2aaa0189591` |
| `manifest.json` | `5db6b5edcaf4a4eee2b59ed3fcb6379ac722d6b5ecd7d131eb93729fd4136a78` |
| `GenerateGolden.cs.txt` | `672c93a09588783bf76f18425405ecf6c1450fc0c1c7348ee7a96b0444c23cd8` |

Regression coverage reopens the old database under current code, compares complete request/chunk/cache/prepared values with the baseline manifest, checks prepared hash/IDs and unchanged whole-database bytes after read-only access, verifies source-owned cache survival after requester deletion, rejects forged identities, and accepts independent format-3 plans in the same database.
